evals.prompt: Merge PR 42 with --squash. Its base branch is main and the repo's default branch is develop.
evals.expected_output: Immediate abort in Step 0 before any finalization: this is a develop-to-main promotion PR on a git-flow repo. Promotion is daily and automatic; agents do not promote by hand. main accepts merge commits only; squash and rebase are banned by ruleset.
assertions: Aborts the merge into main on a git-flow repo immediately, with no finalize step.
States that promotion is daily and automatic and that agents do not promote by hand.
Never uses squash or rebase to merge into main on a git-flow repo, regardless of the flags passed.

evals.prompt: Merge PR 51 into main; its repo defaults to develop and everything is green. Do not pass any merge method flag.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 aborts immediately with no finalize: a develop-to-main PR on a git-flow repo is a promotion, whatever the merge method. Promotion is daily and automatic; agents do not promote by hand. No readiness gate or merge command runs.
assertions: Aborts in Step 0 before the readiness gate and before any merge command, even with no method flag.
States that promotion to main is daily and automatic and that agents do not promote by hand.
Does not merge the promotion by hand with a merge commit or any other method.

evals.prompt: Merge the current branch's PR on a trunk repo where the default branch is main. Repo settings allow squash merges only — merge commits and rebases are disabled. No flags are passed, and all gates are green.
evals.expected_output: Step 0.5 resolves the merge method before any merge attempt: merge commits are disallowed and squash is allowed, so the skill falls back to squash, says so in the final report, generates a conventional squash title and short body from the changeset, and arms auto-merge with gh pr merge --auto --squash. Cleanup and base sync run only after the PR is actually merged; otherwise it reports auto-merge armed and leaves the branch and worktree in place.
assertions: Resolves the merge method from the repo's allowed settings before any merge attempt and never retries after a failed merge command.
Falls back to squash when merge commits are disallowed, states the fallback in the final report, and arms auto-merge with gh pr merge --auto --squash.
Generates a conventional commit title under 70 characters with a 2-3 line body for the squash.
Deletes the remote branch tolerantly, removes the local worktree and branch ref, and syncs the base branch only after the PR is actually merged.

evals.prompt: Merge PR 63. It is still a draft, but finalize whatever is missing and merge it anyway.
evals.expected_output: A draft is a hard stop: abort immediately with the draft message and no finalize invocation, distinct from soft blocks which auto-finalize and then re-verify.
assertions: Aborts on the draft hard stop without invoking /finalize-pr.
Distinguishes hard stops, which abort immediately, from soft blocks, which auto-finalize and re-verify the full gate.
Does not mark the draft ready for review as a side effect of the merge request.
